description:
Full property record for a UPRN, grouped into tiers: identity, property,
    energy, building, land, risk, designations, infrastructure, ownership,
    provenance. Up to ~300 fields — null fields are omitted, so a typical
    urban flat returns fewer than a rural site with designations on it.
    `provenance` carries the `<field>_source` and `<field>_confidence`
    siblings, so you can trust individual cells and not just rows.
    UK only. Costs 25 credits (25p). Keyed on a UPRN, not an address: call `address_autocomplete` (free) to narrow, then `address_resolve` to get one.
name: property_lookup
title: Full property record
